nodes.name: Symmetric Positive Definite Cholesky Solver
nodes.description: Symmetric/Hermitian positive-definite matrix Cholesky factorization and back-solving linear system family.

nodes.name: cholesky_factorize
nodes.description: Compute the Cholesky factorization of a symmetric/Hermitian positive-definite matrix A.
nodes.type_signature: (A: NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128], lower: bool = False) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128], bool]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Cholesky decomposition of an N x N matrix requires N^3 / 3 floating point operations and O(N^2) space to store the factored matrix in place.

nodes.name: cholesky_solve
nodes.description: Solve the symmetric positive-definite system A x = b using precomputed Cholesky factor.
nodes.type_signature: (c_factor: tuple[NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128], bool], b: NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128]) -> NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Back-solving with precomputed Cholesky factors against a single RHS vector takes O(N^2) operations via forward/backward substitutions and O(N) auxiliary space.
